description: Source code for a custom guardrail implementation interfacing with HiddenLayer API, including authentication, request handling, and guardrail application logic.

classes.name: HiddenlayerGuardrail
classes.description: A custom guardrail class that integrates with HiddenLayer API for safety checks, including JWT authentication and request validation.

methods.name: is_saas
methods.description: Checks whether the provided host URL points to the HiddenLayer SaaS platform.

methods.name: _get_jwt
methods.description: Retrieves a JWT token from HiddenLayer authentication endpoint using client credentials.

methods.name: apply_guardrail
methods.description: Validates and potentially redacts input data via HiddenLayer before or after LLM calls.

methods.name: _call_hiddenlayer
methods.description: Makes an HTTP POST request to HiddenLayer API to perform detection or validation, handling token refresh on 401 errors.

methods.name: get_config_model
methods.description: Returns the configuration model class for this guardrail.
